_tables: P06 rigs the yacc tables: state 0 (parseStateActions[0]=40) shifts token t (1..19) into the reduce state of one P06 rule (t=1 0x191, 2 0x1A0, 3 0x19F, 4 0x19B, 5 0x19A, 6 0x199, 7 0x198, 8 0x197, 9 0x193, 10 0x192, 11 0x26 via default-rule state 2, 12 0x18F, 13 0x18E, 14 0x18D, 15 0x18A, 16 0x189, 17 0x188, 18 0x1C5, 19 0x185); each rule has length 1 and its goto is state 0, where the lexer's -2 aborts. Value stack slot k sits at @valueStack+0x100+0x10*k; with p rules reduced before the target, top = slot 2+p (slot 1 is always zero, slot 0 and below are fixture memory).
_lists: list = {capacity, stride, count, data}; frame lists are recorded by content (mem:16). parseListAppend is a stub: its first call makes the list {10, 4, 1, 0x100abf80}, its second {10, 4, 2, 0x100abf80} (the allocating helpers would reach the CRT heap).
